findings.claim: Proposition 3.3 orbit-family indexing and dependent general orbifold spectral-sequence first page
findings.suspect_step: Every nonminimal isotropy group is assigned a unique maximal smaller group G^-.
findings.demonstration: Weighted Reeb action on S5 with weights (2,3,6) has S={e,Z2,Z3,Z6}; Z6 has incomparable maximal proper groups Z2,Z3. Choosing Z3 as predecessor inserts M^Z6=S1 at period1/2 where full fixed set is S3, duplicating/misidentifying a family; choosing Z2 fails at period1/3.
findings.impact: The displayed E1 input is not defined/correct for an allowed general quasi-regular action; regular free-action case unaffected.
findings.counterevidence: Local orbit discrepancy formula and regular Hopf/index tests remain consistent. A direct corrected indexing supports the abstract survival proof.
findings.repair_status: Verified replacement by period T and connected components of Fix(phi_T); clean fixed set, nullity/parity and abstract minimum-degree survival checked. Full Floer foundations remain dependencies.

acceptance_check.claim_location: PDF p.17 / printed p.197, definition of G^- and Proposition3.3(1); dependent first page PDF p.21 / printed p.201; parity and survival PDF pp.18,22-23 / printed pp.198,202-203.
acceptance_check.hypotheses: The action on S5 with positive integral weights(2,3,6) is effective since gcd=1 and quasi-regular. H=2|z1|^2+3|z2|^2+6|z3|^2>0; eta=alpha0/H has eta(R)=1 and i_R d eta=0 because R(H)=0 and i_R d alpha0=-dH. It has the standard contact distribution, c1=0 since H2(S5;Z)=0, smooth link and positive R(M)=11. The smooth standard contact sphere admits its usual ball filling with c1=0.
acceptance_check.decisive_check: The stabilizer orders are1,2,3,6. Z2 and Z3 are incomparable maximal proper members belowZ6. At T=1/6,1/3,1/2,1 the full fixed sets are respectively S1(z3),S3(z2,z3),S3(z1,z3),S5. Selecting Z3 as G^- for Z6 incorrectly creates an S1 family at T=1/2 while the full family is S3 and Z2 already contributes it; selecting Z2 gives the analogous failure atT=1/3. The extra fixed complex direction also changes nullity; this is not harmless relabeling.
acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_boundary: The free circle-action case has no such branching. The report does not refute Theorem1.1 or other main statements, and retains the filling/c1 hypothesis of Theorem1.4 and the smooth-link/Shokurov conditionality. Remark3.9's stated foundational caveat is retained.
acceptance_check.repair_check: Use each positive period T and connected component of Fix(phi_T) exactly once. A compact-circle invariant metric gives ker(d phi_T-I)=T Fix(phi_T). The contact nullity is twice the complex quotient dimension and the nontrivial complex eigenvalues give positive real det(I-d phi_T), preserving the mod2 bottom degree n-1. With R(M)>0, only finitely many period types attain the minimum rational degree; choose maximum period. An incoming degree-minus-one differential would originate at a larger period from odd positive homology degree j, forcing a bottom class of degree at most the chosen minimum at that larger period. This contradicts the extremal choice. Full Floer orientation/transversality foundations remain dependencies.
acceptance_check.severity_reason: The invalid enumeration is the explicit general-orbifold E1 input used in Proposition3.8 and the central homological discrepancy argument. This supports Major even though a local enumeration repair is available.

clarifications.detail: Remark3.9 explicitly notes unfinished linearized-contact-homology foundations; not used to erase Theorem1.4 filling hypothesis.

outcome: Major correction to core general-orbifold orbit enumeration; explicit correction and surviving abstract argument supplied; no main theorem counterexample
acceptance_summary: The existing Major finding is retained. The (2,3,6) weighted Reeb action satisfies the general quasi-regular hypotheses and disproves the unique-predecessor enumeration. The corrected period/component enumeration and its lowest-degree survival argument are valid in the explicitly limited sense stated by the report. No main theorem is disproved.
acceptance_limits: Focused verification of the existing Problem only; no new whole-paper review.
No independent reconstruction of Floer foundations, algebraic valuation proofs, or external metric/classification theorems.
Initial report wording about pending acceptance is historical; current independent acceptance is recorded in provenance while human scientific adjudication remains pending.
